segments.he:
(בָּבָא מְצִיעָא  נט.):  'אוֹקִירוּ  לִנְשַׁיְכוּ  כִּי  הֵיכִי
דְּתִתְעַתְרוּ':
תקעח
(קלה) עוֹדשָׁמַעְתִּי שֶׁאָמַר רַבֵּנוּ זִכְרוֹנוֹ לִבְרָכָה 'פְּסָל לְךָ הַפְּסֹלֶת יִהְיֶה  שֶׁלְּךָ'
segments.en: (135.) I also heard that Rabbainu z"l said: "'Carve for yourself' — the chips will be yours" [Nedarim 38a] — meaning wherever you see some chip or refuse, take that chip as belonging to you — attribute the shortcoming to yourself. "From there Moses became wealthy" [Vayikra Rabbah 1] — meaning through this he merited wisdom etc. (Perhaps his intention is in the way our Rabbis of blessed memory said: "If you have acquired knowledge — what have you lacked?")
